projects.title: A-Life: Artificial Life Simulator
projects.shortDescription: Educational game teaching evolution through interactive artificial life simulation with day cycles, pathfinding, and biome exploration.
projects.longDescription: A team-led capstone project partner with William Pfiel, combining evolutionary biology education with engaging video game mechanics. The simulator features interactive biome worlds, autonomous creature behavior with pathfinding, dynamic day cycles, and event-driven systems. Designed to make AI and evolution concepts accessible while maintaining scientific rigor and gameplay fun.

projects.title: Intel Facilities Power BI Dashboards
projects.shortDescription: Four Power BI dashboards for facility operations: electrical capacity, pump health, truck traffic, and water treatment.
projects.longDescription: Designed and shipped four Power BI dashboards as a MECOP Data Solutions intern. The Electrical Capacity Report let RA SOs compare capacity vs. demand for electrical systems and panels (3hr/month efficiency gain). The Pump Health Monitoring dashboard automated oil and vibration data collection via macro and SCADA, created an Overall Pump Health Summary, and was proliferated to sites in Israel, Ireland, and New Mexico (saving ~3hr/wk per SO). The Truck Loading Heat Map combined a Security Guard data-collection app with real-time Power BI visualizations for site master planning. The Water Treatment Report transformed DEF pipe and vendor data into a structured report modeled on the Israel site format.

projects.title: Intel Python Automation & Other Engagements
projects.shortDescription: Python scripting, API integrations, and IAPM Subgroup BKMs DST support alongside the core dashboard work.
projects.longDescription: Contributed to additional engagements beyond the four main dashboards: wrote Python automation scripts and API integrations to support data pipelines, and participated in IAPM Subgroup BKMs DST activities. Also gained hands-on exposure to the Software Development Life Cycle in an enterprise environment, working through challenges like SCADA portal downtime, large heterogeneous datasets, and cross-site data discrepancies.

projects.title: Regence App Feature Contributions
projects.shortDescription: Shipped user-facing features in the Regence React Native app using TypeScript and Redux.
projects.longDescription: Contributed to the flagship Regence React Native app by implementing key user-facing features: the My Account onboarding tutorial (sign-in, biometrics, contact info), claims submission flow updates, message center, and the Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity section. Also improved parity across web, mobile, Regence, and Asuris experiences and updated core app dependencies.

projects.title: Tech Debt Reduction & Unit Testing
projects.shortDescription: Refactored Redux to Redux Toolkit and authored Jest snapshot tests for the Regence codebase.
projects.longDescription: Reduced technical debt by migrating the Regence app from Redux to Redux Toolkit — eliminating boilerplate, improving readability, removing dead code, and improving overall architecture. Alongside the refactor, authored Jest unit and snapshot tests to reduce complexity, catch future defects, and improve team confidence in the codebase.

projects.title: Manufacturing Data Pipelines & Platform Support
projects.shortDescription: C#/MSSQL backend processes and REST API integrations for a machine installation management platform used across semiconductor fabs.
projects.longDescription: Designed and maintained backend processes that feed real-time manufacturing data into dashboards using C# and MSSQL. Supported REST API integrations and backend logic to automate report generation, strengthen data pipelines, and keep a machine installation management platform reliable for a global semiconductor customer base. Also partnered with engineers and business analysts to translate operational requirements into product objectives and platform improvements.

projects.title: Power BI Reporting Ownership
projects.shortDescription: Sole maintainer of Power BI reports supporting business decisions and manufacturing visibility.
projects.longDescription: Create and refine Power BI reports that support business decision-making across the platform, ensuring accuracy, performance, and alignment with evolving business needs. Analyze key performance data for customers, manage complex datasets for workload planning, and incorporate Primavera P6 scheduling context into reporting so technical and non-technical stakeholders can act on the same operational picture.

projects.title: Enterprise Application Support
projects.shortDescription: Provided frontline application support for more than 6,000 users while owning most of the support volume across the platform.
projects.longDescription: Single-handedly supported more than 6,000 users on BaseSite's machine installation management platform while handling 66% of all application support work. Partnered directly with engineers, business analysts, and non-technical users to resolve issues quickly, maintain platform stability, and keep operational workflows moving across a large semiconductor-facing organization.

projects.title: LSPx
projects.shortDescription: Web platform helping semiconductor manufacturers plan and manage the installation of complex machinery inside fabrication facilities.
projects.longDescription: LSPx is BaseSite's core web product — a platform that helps semiconductor manufacturers coordinate the end-to-end installation of complex equipment inside fabs. It manages installation schedules, equipment dependencies, stakeholder communication, and status tracking across a global user base. Contributed to application support, backend data pipelines, API integrations, and feature maintenance that keep the platform reliable for thousands of engineers and project managers working in semiconductor fabrication.
